# Charity Navigator

> Charity Navigator provides ratings, evaluations, and donor tools to help individuals make informed charitable giving decisions across 225,000+ nonprofits.

Charity Navigator is a 501(c)(3) organization that offers comprehensive charity ratings, AI-powered search capabilities, and giving tools like Giving Basket to facilitate tax-deductible donations. The platform combines financial accountability data with donor resources to guide philanthropic decisions.

## Key Topics

- Charity ratings
- Donor resources
- Charity search
- Horizon AI Search
- Giving Basket
- Charitable donations
- Nonprofit evaluation
- Cause-based giving
- Tax-deductible giving
- 501(c)(3) organizations
- Philanthropic guidance
- Charity evaluation
- Donation platform
- Financial accountability
- EIN lookup

## Core Platform

- [Charity Navigator Home](https://www.charitynavigator.org): Homepage: Charity Navigator's ratings and donor resources platform
- [Main Platform](https://www.charitynavigator.org/.html): Main platform page for charity ratings and donor resources
- [About Charity Navigator](https://www.charitynavigator.org/about-us): About page detailing Charity Navigator's mission and 225K+ ratings

## Giving Tools & Features

- [Horizon AI Search](http://www.charitynavigator.org/ai-search): Horizon AI Search tool for discovering charities by cause
- [Giving Basket](https://www.charitynavigator.org/givingbasket): Giving Basket tool for multi-charity donations with privacy control

## Donations & Support

- [Donate to Charity Navigator](https://give.charitynavigator.org/campaign/713794/donate): Donation page for supporting Charity Navigator's 501(c)(3) mission
- [Charity Navigator Rating](https://www.charitynavigator.org/ein/134148824): Charity Navigator's own 4-star rating and financial accountability data

## User Account

- [Logout](https://www.charitynavigator.org/auth/logout): Logout page for authenticated Charity Navigator users
